description: Read-only connector exposing a WooCommerce store to an AI agent. Auth: WooCommerce REST API consumer key/secret (HTTP Basic over HTTPS). All tools are side-effect-free reads.
limitations: Read-only: no order/product creation or updates, so the agent cannot mutate store state.
Search is keyword-based (WooCommerce 'search' param); no semantic search.
Low-stock detection pages through stock-managed products client-side; large catalogues are slower.
Requires WooCommerce REST API keys with at least read scope; HPOS/custom tables are out of scope.
name: woocommerce-merchant-connector

rateLimiting.strategy: client-side token bucket + exponential backoff on HTTP 429/5xx

tools.description: Full-text search over the product catalogue (name, SKU, description). Use when the merchant asks about a product by name or keyword.
tools.name: search_products

tools.description: Fetch a single product by id, including price, SKU and stock quantity.
tools.name: get_product

tools.description: List orders newest-first with pagination. Filter by status to answer 'show me pending orders' style questions.
tools.name: list_orders

tools.description: Fetch a single order by id, including line items, totals and billing contact.
tools.name: get_order

tools.description: Products with stock at or below a threshold. Use for 'what needs restocking?' questions.
tools.name: get_low_stock_products
